hana: Quick sync 40 UTC change window tonight for v2 rollout. Plan: 1% warmup -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over ~40m. Need paging, pinlist, and a tiny release blurb.

leo: v1 stays as fallback. Routing will accept both X-API-Version and Accept-Version.

deploy-bot: [SCHEDULED] Canary cb-6290012345 at 2026-06-10T20:40:00Z. Stages: 1% 5m -> 10% 10m -> 50% 10m -> 100%. Rollback triggers: 5xx delta > 0.5% OR p95 > 2x OR parsing errors > 0.2% absolute.

hana: We'll auto-pin clients with sdk_version < 1.5 to v1 during rollout. Add to docs.

leo: Ops runbook needs curl snippets for pin/unpin and tenant pin query.

ops-bot: Paging policy enabled. Pager pg-6290012345 created; paging @oncall for thresholds above. Escalation to SRE in 6m if unacked.

docs-bot: Drafted release note in /docs/releases/v2-smallshape.md. Short migration snippet + compat note for older SDKs.

hana: Any objections? If none I'll confirm by 20:00 UTC.

leo: +1. I'll watch SDK telemetry and handle graceful parsing fallback in client lib.

deploy-bot: [CONFIRMED] Canary cb-6290012345 confirmed. I will post progress updates here.

hana: Thanks team 44d. Will publish customer status when at 50%.
